primary.title: Multi-Asset Funds: Can one fund do the job of five investments – equity, debt, gold, silver and real estate?
primary.summary: As per SEBI categorisation, a multi-asset allocation fund must invest at least 10% in each of three different asset classes. Beyond this, fund houses have flexibility in deciding how to construct and manage these funds.
